description.narrative: Danish contribution to the core activities of the Core Humanitarian Standard Alliance, since 2020

Denmark has actively supported the development of the Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS) and the establishment of CHS Alliance in order to ensure high humanitarian standards and accountability in the humanitarian sector.
CHSA is responsible for the maintenance and the dissemination of the Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS). The CHSA has 157 members (220 organisations) who align with the CHS. The CHSA has played an active role in relation to the PSEAH agenda and ensured that PSEAH save guarding mechanisms are included in the CHS. The work of CHAS is an important element of Danish quality assurance of partners and accountability to affected populations.
The partner’s results description and results frameworks are global, general, and highly aggregated and the MFA core contribution is thus reflected in the overall results reporting by the partner. Please refer to the hyperlink below.
https://www.chsalliance.org/about/
